text:
Tree-cover loss occurred in 2023, but the evidence does not show that it was deforestation.

Hansen/UMD mapped about 0.7 ha of tree-cover loss on the asset in 2023 (1.2% of its 58.1 ha). The result is corroborated: later years through 2025 were observed, and the JRC 2020 map agrees the area was forest. A further 0.4 ha of loss in patches under 0.5 ha was detected but not counted as an event.

The MGAP 2021 map shows no native forest in the loss area. It is mostly planted Eucalyptus (0.4 ha), with 0.3 ha outside mapped forest. Hansen loss includes any stand replacement, such as harvesting a plantation, so this may well be plantation cutting rather than land-use change.

The evidence does not establish the cause (harvest, fire, storm, clearing), the legality, who was responsible, or any compliance status such as EUDR.
